hooks.command: d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; s=$(printf '%s' "$d" | sed 's/[\/:]/-/g'); dir="$HOME/.claude/projects/$s"; f=$(ls -t "$dir"/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/token-report.js" ] || exit 0; node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/token-report.js" "$f" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 2
